<thought>We need to combine the three subnetworks into a single circuit description. Subnet 1 provides two resistors (R1 and R2) and their connections A‑N1 and N1‑X1. Subnet 3 provides three resistors (R1, R2, R3) and connections X2‑N1, N1‑N2, N2‑B. Subnet 2 is a single resistor of 5 Ω that matches the measured resistance between N_b1 and X1, so we add it as a separate element. All resistor identifiers are made unique across the whole network. The combined topology is expressed as a JSON object with a “resistors” dictionary and a “connections” list.</thought>
<final_answer>{"resistors": {"R1_1": 2.222, "R2_1": 4.444, "R1_3": 2.727, "R2_3": 5.454, "R3_3": 8.182, "R4": 5.0}, "connections": [["A", "N1", "R1_1"], ["N1", "X1", "R2_1"], ["N_b1", "X1", "R4"], ["X2", "N1", "R1_3"], ["N1", "N2", "R2_3"], ["N2", "B", "R3_3"]]}
